run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T08:49:40Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy (alert reported current 2.0444444444444443, startsAt 2026-11-15T08:49:40Z) is a downstream symptom of the checkout Deployment being rolled onto an unstartable pod. At 08:49:47-08:49:57Z the checkout Deployment scaled down its working ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and scaled up ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99, whose pod template image is "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" - a reference containing a literal newline. The kubelet cannot parse it (InspectFailed / Failed "Error: InvalidImageName", "couldn't parse image name ... invalid reference format"), so pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 remains Pending with no running checkout container, and the checkout Service endpoints object holds only notReadyAddresses. checkout server spans stop (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 5m increase ~206-212 through the bucket ending 08:49:40, then 153.33, 112.22, 74.44, 41.11 and 0 from the bucket ending 08:55:40 onward). The only failing request path is frontend POST /api/checkout -> grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder: 373.6842105263158 error spans versus 2.1052631578947367 non-error spans in the 10m ending 09:00:00Z, while frontend's other routes and operations show 0 error increase. frontend-proxy's own access log marks the 500s as "via_upstream" from upstream frontend on POST /api/checkout only, with /api/cart, /api/products and /api/data returning 200, so frontend-proxy is the reporter, not the origin. frontend-proxy error spans on span_name="ingress" and "router frontend egress" rose from a small background of 1.11-5.56 per 5m (buckets 08:31:40-08:50:40) to 43.33-226.67 per 5m from the bucket ending 08:51:40, a span error ratio of 5.549664192294097 at 09:00:00Z. The checkout outage was still active at the end of the observation (pod Pending, Deployment Available=False since 08:49:57Z).

claims.text: frontend-proxy records STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on exactly two operations, span_name="ingress" and span_name="router frontend egress"; 5-minute increase was 0-5.56 per bucket from the bucket ending 08:30:40 through 08:50:40, then 43.333333333333336 (08:51:40), 80, 136.66666666666669, 181.11111111111111, 224.44444444444446 (08:55:40), staying 65-227 through 09:03:40, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET volume stayed roughly flat (about 3600-3900 per 5m) until a traffic decline after 08:59:40.

The frontend-proxy error-span ratio, 100 * sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy"}[5m])), was 5.549664192294097 at evaluation time 2026-11-15T09:00:00Z.

At 09:00:00Z the errors are confined to the checkout path: frontend span_name="executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" had increase 373.6842105263158 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans versus 2.1052631578947367 STATUS_CODE_UNSET in 10m, and frontend span_name="grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" had 373.6842105263158 error spans; frontend operations grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart and GET each had 0 error increase.

frontend-proxy access logs (newest 60 of 9485 matching lines in 08:45-09:05, lines_omitted 9425) contain lines such as "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream ... "frontend" while GET /api/products/*, POST /api/cart, GET /api/cart and GET /api/data return 200 - via_upstream; the 500s are attributed to upstream "frontend" on the checkout route only.

checkout server-side traffic ceases: increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"} was ~206-212 per 5m through the bucket ending 08:49:40, then 153.33333333333334 (08:51:40), 112.22222222222223, 74.44444444444444, 41.111111111111114 (08:54:40) and 0 from the bucket ending 08:55:40 through 09:03:40; every checkout series in the window carries only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so checkout reports no error spans of its own.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (controller owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99, startTime 2026-11-15T08:49:57Z) is phase Pending with container "checkout" ready=false, restartCount=0 and waiting reason InvalidImageName; it is the only checkout pod present and no checkout application container is running.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout specifies container image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (literal newline before the tag) and its status is Available=False, reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, message "Deployment does not have minimum availability.", with replicas=1, unavailableReplicas=1, updatedReplicas=1, observedGeneration=4, and a Progressing condition lastUpdateTime 2026-11-15T08:49:50Z.

The exact kubelet diagnostic is: Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format (event reason InspectFailed, followed by Warning reason Failed, message "Error: InvalidImageName"), recorded for pod checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx at 2026-11-15T08:49:50Z and for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68.

The rollout that caused this happened at 08:49:47-08:49:57Z: Deployment checkout scaled ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0 and deleted pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq (SuccessfulDelete, "Stopping container checkout" at 08:49:50Z), and scaled ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1, creating pods checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx (08:49:47Z) and checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (08:49:57Z); both new pods failed on the unparseable image.

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 2026-11-15T08:11:42Z, owner Deployment checkout) has spec.replicas=0 and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, while ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (created 2026-11-15T08:49:47Z, same owner Deployment checkout) has spec.replicas=1 with image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" and no ready replicas.

The checkout Service has no ready backend: its endpoints object contains only notReadyAddresses for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (ip 100.96.4.211, targetRef kind Pod, port 8080), so requests routed to the checkout service cannot be served.

A pre-incident baseline at 08:45:00Z (15m window from 08:30:00Z) shows the checkout path was clean: increase was 0 for frontend span_name="executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and 0 for span_name="grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder", and frontend-proxy error increase was only 6.206896551724139 on ingress and 0 on "router frontend egress". This supports the error burst starting with the checkout rollout; it also shows a small non-zero background on frontend-proxy ingress (1.11-5.56 per 5m from the bucket ending 08:31:40), which on its own would satisfy an alert threshold of greater than 0.

Other services that report spans show no matching error burst: in the 10m ending 09:00:00Z payment (GET, dns.lookup, tcp.connect), cart (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream) and accounting (orders receive) had error increase 0, and ad, fraud-detection and recommendation had only 1.0526315789473684 error spans each on their flagd evaluation operations.

Hypothesis that frontend-proxy itself is the failing component is rejected: its error spans are limited to span_name="ingress" and "router frontend egress", its access log marks the 500s as "via_upstream" to upstream "frontend" on POST /api/checkout only, and its other routes returned 200. frontend-proxy reports an upstream failure rather than originating it.

Hypothesis that a Kafka dependency failure broke checkout is rejected: both new checkout pods started the init container wait-for-kafka successfully (busybox:latest pulled, "Created container: wait-for-kafka", "Started container: wait-for-kafka" at 08:49:48Z and 08:49:58Z), and the failure occurred while inspecting/judging the main checkout image, which was never created; pod kafka-ff7884766-l5bsp is Running and ready with 0 restarts.

The deepest supported cause is a bad configuration change to the checkout Deployment: its pod-template image was set to "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0", which differs from the image the previous ReplicaSet ran (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and is not a valid reference because of the embedded newline, so no checkout container can be created and PlaceOrder calls fail with 500s surfaced by frontend and counted by frontend-proxy. Whether the newline came from templating/substitution, a pasted value or an automated pipeline is not verifiable from the available data.

A separate change inside the window not tied to this failure: pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b has a previous container instance terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-15T08:29:35Z, restartCount 1, and the container is now ready; its error signal is small and unchanged between baseline and incident (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error increase 1.0344827586206897 in the 15m ending 08:45:00Z versus 1.0526315789473684 in the 10m ending 09:00:00Z).

Restore Deployment otel-demo/checkout's container image to a valid checkout image reference (the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb ran ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) with no embedded whitespace or newline, then confirm the replacement pod reaches Ready, the checkout Service endpoints object gains a ready address, and frontend span_name="grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" returns to an error increase of 0.

Add validation of container image references (reject values containing newlines or whitespace, or that fail reference parsing) in the pipeline or admission path that produced "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0", and review the source value that substituted the checkout image, since a syntactically invalid image rolled a healthy pod out of service.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who or what edited the checkout Deployment image, and the exact edit time, could not be verified; only resulting objects and events are visible (ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 created 08:49:47Z, old pod deleted 08:49:50Z).

Jaeger trace searches returned no_data for frontend-proxy (08:45-09:05 and 09:00-09:10), frontend (08:45-09:05) and checkout (08:49:40-09:10:50) even though traces_list_services lists checkout, frontend and frontend-proxy, so span-level error messages, span status details and parent-child call edges for the failing PlaceOrder calls are unverified; the 5.549664192294097 figure is a Prometheus span-metric ratio, not a request failure rate.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 returned no_data (0 lines for 08:45-09:05), so the frontend-side error text and its gRPC failure detail could not be read.

fetch_pod_logs for checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 returned no_data: the main checkout container was never created (only the wait-for-kafka init container ran), and previous pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq was deleted at 08:49:50Z so its logs are no longer available.

kube-state-metrics series including kube_deployment_status_replicas_available and the kube_deployment.* family are absent from this Prometheus (get_metric_names and metrics_range_query returned no_data), so checkout availability could only be read as point-in-time Kubernetes API state, not as a time series across the incident window.

list_prometheus_rules returned no_data both for rule_name RequestErrorRate and for type=alert, so the alert's exact PromQL expression, threshold and evaluation interval could not be confirmed, and the reported current value 2.0444444444444443 could not be reproduced exactly.
The frontend-proxy log view used is incomplete (limit reached: newest 60 of 9485 matching lines shown, lines_omitted 9425), so earlier lines in 08:45-09:05 were not read.
ConfigMap inspection for the value "hello-bench" returned no_data, so the source of the checkout image value could not be traced to a ConfigMap in this namespace.

The cause of the small pre-existing frontend-proxy error background (1.11-5.56 error spans per 5m between buckets 08:31:40 and 08:50:40, before and around the checkout rollout) was not identified; it is too small to explain the 43-227 per 5m burst but would satisfy a greater-than-zero alert threshold on its own.
Whether any checkout caller other than frontend broke is unverified: only frontend's checkout operations were observed failing, and no other service's checkout-calling spans were examined.
next_steps: Restore the checkout Deployment pod template to a valid image reference (previous working image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and verify a Ready pod plus a ready checkout Service endpoint, then watch frontend-proxy /api/checkout 5xx and frontend PlaceOrder error spans return to zero.
Audit the CI/CD source or values file that supplied "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (trailing newline) and add image-reference validation before rollout.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the alerting configuration (not available via list_prometheus_rules here) to confirm its expression, and consider a threshold above the small baseline error background.
Re-check Jaeger retention or collector sampling for the incident window if span-level detail on the failed PlaceOrder calls is required.
